SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-12-2013 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HUMAN SERVICES AGENCY OF THE CITY & COUNTY OF SF (SAN FRANCISCO) RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BEASLEY, LAKISHA $4,043.00 PRINCIPAL, $65.50 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,108.50, BASED ON THE FACTS ESTABLISHED AT THE ADMINISTRATIVE HEARING, THAT THE DEFENDANT MADE INTENTIONAL FALSE STATEMENTS TO OBTAIN CAL WORKS PROGRAM BENEFITS, LAKISHA BEASLEY ENGAGED IN FRAUDULENT CONDUCT.
